item.name: Wait for the welcome entry in the history

exec: // Notification takes user.registered from notification.q in the background.
// Asked again every 1 s, at most 15 more times (no fixed sleep).

const again = () => ({ url: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}/notifications/me?size=100'), method: 'GET', header: [{ key: 'X-User-Id', value: pm.variables.get('customerUserId') }, { key: 'X-User-Roles', value: 'CUSTOMER' }, { key: 'X-Request-Id', value: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}') }] });
const ready = (res) => Boolean(res) && res.code === 200 && res.json().items.some((entry) => entry.type === 'user.registered');
pm.test('history has the e-mail of user.registered: "Witamy w sklepie"', () => {
setTimeout(() => pm.sendRequest(again(), (error, next) => wait(tries + 1, error ? null : next)), 1000);
